headline: Ukraine's defense needs in 2027 are $75 billion more than budgeted, Ministry of Finance says
summary: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence estimates the increase in defence spending for 2027 at $175 billion. The government draft budget does not fully cover this need.
why: Ukraine's budget depends heavily on external financing, so the size of its defence funding gap affects the sovereign's fiscal position and external support needs.
